atoms.text: Blinky is visiting us from another planet. Can you help them learn about our world?

instruction.text: Spell the word to tell Blinky the name of our planet.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9'>Does the Earth have a moon?</voice>

instruction.text: Our moon goes around the Earth. Can you point out the moon to Blinky?

feedback.end: Did you know that the moon doesn’t disappear during the day? We just can’t see it when the sky is bright.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9'>What keeps you warm on Earth?</voice>

instruction.text: Our Earth goes around the Sun. Can you point out the Sun to Blinky?

feedback.end: The amount of time it takes for the Earth to go around the Sun is 1 year.

atoms.a: “What do the Earth, Sun, and Moon have in common?”
